releases.description:
Spherical Graph 1.0.0 is the first stable desktop release.

Highlights:
- Seam-free fixed note layout computed intrinsically on a sphere.
- Explicit Initialize, Refresh, and Renew lifecycle with transactional persistence.
- Cyberpunk Three.js globe with tangent node markers, geodesic links, zoom-gated labels, and responsive selection details.
- All-shortest-route navigation with distinct endpoint and route highlighting.
- Selectable tag satellites on an adjustable orbit with occlusion and spiral links.
- Automatic Globe sizing, configurable appearance, search, clickable note details, and camera controls.

Privacy and security:
- No telemetry, ads, accounts, runtime network calls, remote code, external-file access, or note-content writes.

Manual installation: download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` from this release into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/spherical-graph/`, then enable **Spherical Graph** in Obsidian.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/Pavel-mik/obsidian-spherical-graph/blob/1.0.0/CHANGELOG.md) and [documentation](https://github.com/Pavel-mik/obsidian-spherical-graph#readme).
